name: EU: GDPR, the AI Act, the medical device regulations and the European Health Data Space
description: EU: GDPR, the AI Act, the medical device regulations and the European Health Data Space. From the Shio policy pack specification; draft, not reviewed.
limits: Draft and unreviewed. Planned controls are listed for coverage and not enforced.

frameworks.title: GDPR, EU AI Act, MDR/IVDR, Clinical Trials Regulation, EHDS

controls.title: Health data has an Article 6 basis and an Article 9 condition
controls.requirement: Health data has an Article 6 basis and an Article 9 condition, named on the request.

controls.title: Fields are limited to the purpose
controls.requirement: Fields are limited to the purpose; pseudonymised data is still personal data.

controls.title: A processor agreement is in force with each model provider and subprocessor
controls.requirement: A processor agreement is in force with each model provider and subprocessor.

controls.title: Transfers outside the EEA have an adequacy decision
controls.requirement: Transfers outside the EEA have an adequacy decision, SCCs or another mechanism.

controls.title: A data protection impact assessment is on file
controls.requirement: A data protection impact assessment is on file.

controls.title: Significant automated decisions have human involvement and can be contested
controls.requirement: Significant automated decisions have human involvement and can be contested.

controls.title: Data subject rights are routed within one month
controls.requirement: Data subject rights are routed within one month.

controls.title: Breach notice to the authority within 72 hours where required
controls.requirement: Breach notice to the authority within 72 hours where required.

controls.title: Records of processing are generated from the agent card
controls.requirement: Records of processing are generated from the agent card.

controls.title: The AI Act risk class and the date its obligations apply are recorded (stand-alone high-ri
controls.requirement: The AI Act risk class and the date its obligations apply are recorded (stand-alone high-risk from 2 Dec 2027, embedded from 2 Aug 2028).

controls.title: High-risk obligations are mapped to the Shio controls that produce their evidence
controls.requirement: High-risk obligations are mapped to the Shio controls that produce their evidence.

controls.title: Transparency duties for systems that interact with people apply where in force
controls.requirement: Transparency duties for systems that interact with people apply where in force.

controls.title: Medical device agents attach their change plan and clinical evaluation
controls.requirement: Medical device agents attach their change plan and clinical evaluation.

controls.title: EU clinical trials follow the Clinical Trials Regulation
controls.requirement: EU clinical trials follow the Clinical Trials Regulation.

controls.title: European Health Data Space duties are tracked as they apply
controls.requirement: European Health Data Space duties are tracked as they apply.
